title: HTTP server surface (BookHandler.do_*) is untested
evidence: test_app.py only drives BookAPI as a WSGI callable; app.py:125-141 (do_GET/do_POST/do_PUT/do_DELETE, dispatch_http, read_body, send_json) are never exercised, accounting for most of the 24% uncovered lines (test_coverage=0.76 from scores.json)
suggestion: Add one integration test that binds BookHandler via ThreadingHTTPServer (or a mock) to cover the production request path

title: Two parallel request surfaces duplicate body-parsing/response logic
evidence: app.py:38-47 (BookAPI.__call__ + _body) and app.py:108-123 (BookHandler.send_json + read_body) re-implement near-identical JSON body read and response encoding
suggestion: Factor the shared body-read/JSON-encode into one helper used by both surfaces

title: PUT performs a full replace, not a partial update
evidence: app.py:81-82 UPDATE sets all columns; omitting year/isbn in a PUT body nulls them (test_app.py:43 asserts year becomes None after update)
suggestion: Behaviour is self-consistent and documented in README; note as replace-semantics if partial PATCH is ever desired
